01133.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge 5.9 miles south of Arley had its wettest month in June at 8.05 inches. The biggest single day came Apr 29 with 3.73 inches. Before that the gauge went 15 days in a row with nothing, from Mar 18 to Apr 1. On the days both years reported, this year is 2.34 inches more than last year.
